newsitem.title: ITALY: Annan asks U.N. members to press Kabila on Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Annan asks U.N. members to press Kabila on Zaire.

text.p: U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan appealed to the international community on Monday to press Zaire's rebel leader Laurent Kabila to accept a ceasefire amd a negotiated solution to his country's crisis.
In a statement issued in Rome, Annan said he was concerned that a five-point peace plan endorsed by the U.N. Security Council had not begun in earnest because there was no firm ceasefire.

"I therefore appeal to all member states to press Mr Kabila and his supporters in the Great Lakes Region to seek a negotiated solution through a ceasefire and sustained talks on the future of Zaire," Annan's statement said.
Annan said he was also encouraged that President Mobutu Sese Seko had agreed to a dialogue with Kabila.
Annan said it was "obvious" that Zaire was on the verge of a major political change but warned that "a durable solution cannot be achieved through military means.

"The stakes are high. If we are successful, Zaire could begin to move in the direction of national reconciliation, democracy and prosperity. If we fail, it will mean misery and stagnation for millions of people in the region," he aadded.
